m2_criterion.definition: Current rights-reviewed Lao Postal Service or legally authorised assignments and independently licensed point, route or area geometry pass declared-scope coverage, assignment validity, CRS/topology, temporal coverage, privacy and provenance checks, with reproducible transformation, approved immutable publication and actual AGID loader/API verification.

definition_basis.rule: Formalize the pre-existing assignment-plus-independent-geometry conditions while preserving all eight hard blockers. No forced official polygon and no automatic address/building relation.

rights_review.operator: The public operator page reserves rights. Its displayed totals and first-region sample establish an observation, not unique postcode counts, a complete current bulk assignment snapshot, exact reuse rights or immutable publication.
rights_review.laopedia: The visible current page and its linked historical revision are explanatory allocation references. No exact reuse/redistribution licence, complete current national assignment coverage or valid-from/to history was verified.
rights_review.geometry: NFMS administrative layer metadata has blank copyright text, Web Mercator metadata and no explicit postal assignment crosswalk. PCode is a field name, not evidence of postcode authority or a join key. No features were queried.
rights_review.privacy: LSB census publication describes buildings, dwellings, households and individual information; it is not an open civic/building corpus. LaoLandReg and Electronic Data Law direct retrievals failed in preflight; their current body, access terms and applicable legal status remain unverified. Cached search text is not a hashed current source.
